entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor here, delivered on December 15th. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It works fine. I just changed my mind.
I understand. Was there a specific feature that didn't meet your expectations? We have a lot of resources to help you get the most out of the device.
No. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I want to return it.
Okay, I appreciate the clarity. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Thanks for your patience, Sarah. I've just checked our policy, and you're all set. The item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
So you're actually going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return authorization now. Normally, for a preference return outside the first couple of weeks, we might direct you to our VeloFit resale marketplace, but there's no need in this case. You're fully covered.
Fine. Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just sent it. You should see an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright then. Thank you for your call, and have a good rest of your day.
